arguments.value: Jennifer Guerin Zipps is a United States District Judge for the District of Arizona, where she has served since her confirmation in 2011 and as chief judge since 2024. Born in Ashland, Ohio, in 1964, she earned her B.A. from the University of Arizona and her J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center. She began her legal career clerking for Judge William C. Canby of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, practiced privately in Tucson, and then served as an assistant U.S. attorney in the District of Arizona from 1995 to 2005 before joining the federal bench as a magistrate judge in 2005.
